title: 🔥 Maya's laptop overheats... the cleaning mistake that cooks the fan #laptopfix #pctips
title_alts: 🧹 Maya cleans a laptop vent the safe way, start to finish #laptopfix #pctips
🚫 Maya's laptop fan dies from one long blast of canned air #laptopfix #pctips
description_hook: A laptop that roars and runs hot is almost always a blocked vent. Here is how to clear it without wrecking the fan.
setting: a home desk and a towel-covered work surface
protagonist_type: a home laptop owner doing her own maintenance

characters.name: Maya
characters.description: thirty-four, black hair tied back, grey hooded sweatshirt, a small screwdriver always in her shirt pocket

claims.basis: round illustrative warm-up period, stated as a rough check rather than a specification

claims.claim: Clean the vent every six months
claims.basis: round illustrative maintenance interval, stated as a habit not a specification

scenes.narration: Your laptop sounds like a hairdryer and runs hot.
scenes.caption: आपका लैपटॉप हेयर ड्रायर जैसा शोर करता है और गरम रहता है
scenes.image_brief: A slim silver laptop open on a cluttered wooden desk, a loose paper beside the side vent lifting in the escaping air, the desk surface next to the vent faintly hazy with heat, warm evening lamp light from the left.

scenes.narration: Dust packs the vent until hot air cannot leave.
scenes.caption: धूल वेंट बंद कर देती है, गरम हवा बाहर नहीं निकल पाती
scenes.image_brief: A very close view of a laptop's side exhaust vent matted over with a grey felt of dust, only thin dark gaps left between the slots, cool white light raking across the surface.

scenes.narration: So the fan spins faster. The chip then slows itself down.
scenes.caption: तो पंखा तेज़ घूमता है और चिप खुद अपनी रफ़्तार घटा लेती है
scenes.image_brief: The opened underside of a laptop showing a small black blower fan with dust-caked blades sitting beside two flattened copper heat pipes, plain bright overhead light, no hands in frame.

scenes.narration: You need a screwdriver, a can of compressed air, and a torch.
scenes.caption: एक पेचकस, कंप्रेस्ड ऐयर का कैन और एक टॉर्च चाहिए
scenes.image_brief: A small Phillips screwdriver, a can of compressed air with its red straw fitted, and a short metal torch laid in a neat row on a folded white towel, even soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Unplug the charger. Pull the battery if it lifts out.
scenes.caption: चार्जर निकालें। बैटरी निकल सकती हो तो वह भी निकालें
scenes.image_brief: A laptop lying face down on a folded towel with its charger unplugged and coiled to one side, a black battery pack lifted out and set beside it, soft daylight from a window.

scenes.narration: Find the intake grille underneath, usually near a corner.
scenes.caption: नीचे किसी कोने के पास हवा खींचने वाली जाली ढूँढें
scenes.image_brief: The clean grey underside of a laptop with a rectangular slotted intake grille near the front left corner, four rubber feet and a row of tiny screws visible, bright even light.

scenes.narration: Blow short bursts through it from outside, never one long blast.
scenes.caption: बाहर से छोटे-छोटे झोंके मारें, एक लंबी फूँक कभी नहीं
scenes.image_brief: A can of compressed air standing angled beside a laptop's underside grille with a small grey puff of dust escaping sideways from the slots, dust motes hanging in bright daylight, no hands in frame.

scenes.narration: Hold the fan blades still with a toothpick while you spray.
scenes.caption: स्प्रे करते समय टूथपिक से पंखे की ब्लेड रोके रखें
scenes.image_brief: A wooden toothpick wedged between the blades of a small laptop fan to stop it turning, grey dust still clinging to the blade edges, bright focused work light on the open chassis.

scenes.narration: Shine the torch in. You should see metal fins, not grey felt.
scenes.caption: टॉर्च डालकर देखें। धूसर रुई नहीं, धातु की परतें दिखनी चाहिए
scenes.image_brief: A torch beam passing through a laptop's cleared vent grille and lighting the thin metal fins behind it, no dust left on the slots, the surrounding room dark so the beam stands out.

scenes.narration: Run it for ten minutes. The fan should settle to a hum.
scenes.caption: दस मिनट चलाएँ। पंखे की आवाज़ धीमी गुनगुनाहट रह जाए
scenes.image_brief: A reassembled laptop open and running on a tidy desk with a small kitchen timer beside it set near ten minutes, a glass of water further back, calm daylight.

scenes.narration: Still loud after cleaning? The paste under the heatsink has dried out.
scenes.caption: सफ़ाई के बाद भी शोर? हीटसिंक के नीचे का पेस्ट सूख गया है
scenes.image_brief: An open laptop chassis with the copper heatsink still bolted down and a crust of cracked grey thermal paste squeezed out at its edge, cool overhead light.

scenes.narration: That needs the heatsink off, and a shop does it cheaply.
scenes.caption: उसके लिए हीटसिंक खोलना पड़ता है, दुकान पर सस्ते में होता है
scenes.image_brief: A repair bench with a laptop heatsink lifted off and laid on an anti static mat beside a small tube of thermal paste and a lint-free wipe, even bright workshop lighting.

scenes.narration: Clean the vent every six months and write it on a calendar.
scenes.caption: हर छह महीने वेंट साफ़ करें और कैलेंडर पर लिख लें
scenes.image_brief: A paper wall calendar pinned above a desk with one date circled and a handwritten note reading clean laptop vent, the closed laptop resting on the desk below, morning light.

title: 📶 Devan's laptop keeps losing Wi-Fi... the one setting nobody checks #wifi #laptopfix
title_alts: 🔌 Devan stops his laptop powering down its own Wi-Fi radio #wifi #laptopfix
🚫 Devan nearly bought a new router his laptop never needed #wifi #laptopfix
description_hook: Your phone holds the signal but the laptop drops it every few minutes. The radio is being switched off to save power.
problem_domain: wireless dropouts on a single computer
setting: a small flat with one router and several devices
protagonist_type: a remote worker with a flaky laptop

characters.name: Devan
characters.description: twenty-eight, short curly hair, faded green t-shirt, a coiled ethernet cable worn round one wrist

claims.basis: round illustrative test duration, stated as a rough check rather than a measurement

scenes.narration: Your phone shows full Wi-Fi. Your laptop keeps dropping out.
scenes.caption: फ़ोन में पूरा वाई-फ़ाई है, लैपटॉप का कनेक्शन टूटता रहता है
scenes.image_brief: A laptop open on a kitchen table showing a wireless icon with no bars, a phone face up beside it showing a full signal icon, bright morning light through a window behind them.

scenes.narration: Most laptops are allowed to power down the Wi-Fi radio.
scenes.caption: ज़्यादातर लैपटॉप वाई-फ़ाई रेडियो की बिजली बंद कर सकते हैं
scenes.image_brief: A close view of a small wireless card seated in an opened laptop with two thin black antenna wires clipped to it, its status light dark, cool even light on the bare circuit board.

scenes.narration: When it wakes back up late, the router has already given up.
scenes.caption: देर से जागने पर राउटर तब तक कनेक्शन छोड़ चुका होता है
scenes.image_brief: A white home router on a bookshelf with its wireless light blinking and an empty dust-free rectangle beside it where a laptop usually sits, dim evening light from a lamp below.

scenes.narration: Write your network name and password on paper before you start.
scenes.caption: शुरू करने से पहले नेटवर्क का नाम और पासवर्ड काग़ पर लिखें
scenes.image_brief: A small notepad on a desk with a network name and a password written out in blue ink, a pen lying across the page and the router's printed label card beside it, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Open the network adapter settings and find your wireless card.
scenes.caption: नेटवर्क अडैप्टर सेटिंग्स खोलें और अपना वायरलेस कार्ड ढूँढें
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen filled with a device list where a wireless network adapter entry is highlighted blue, a properties window opening over it, cool screen glow in a dim room.

scenes.narration: Turn off the setting that lets the computer power it down.
scenes.caption: वह सेटिंग बंद करें जो कंप्यूटर को बिजली काटने देती है
scenes.image_brief: A tight view of a power management tab on a laptop screen with a single checkbox left unticked beside the words allow the computer to turn off this device, cool screen light.

scenes.narration: Then forget the network. Join it again with the password.
scenes.caption: अब नेटवर्क भूल जाएँ। पासवर्ड डालकर फिर से जुड़ें
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing a list of saved wireless networks with a forget button under the highlighted one and an empty password box waiting below, the notepad visible at the edge of the desk, cool screen light.

scenes.narration: Stream a video for five minutes while you walk around the house.
scenes.caption: घर में घूमते हुए पाँच मिनट तक वीडियो चलाकर देखें
scenes.image_brief: A laptop balanced on a sofa arm playing a video, a long hallway and an open doorway visible beyond it, soft afternoon light coming through half-drawn curtains.

scenes.narration: No stutter? Good. The radio now stays awake.
scenes.caption: रुकावट नहीं? बढ़िया। अब रेडियो जागता रहता है
scenes.image_brief: A laptop resting on a made bed with a video playing smoothly and a full wireless icon in the corner of the screen, a warm bedside lamp lighting the room.

scenes.narration: If every device in the house drops, blame the router instead.
scenes.caption: अगर घर का हर डिवाइस टूटता है तो दोष राउटर का है
scenes.image_brief: A living room side table holding a router, with a tablet, a phone and a laptop arranged around it and each screen showing a warning triangle over its wireless icon, flat grey daylight.

scenes.narration: A rented box with a dead antenna is a swap, not a fix.
scenes.caption: मरे हुए एंटीना वाला किराए का बॉक्स बदलना पड़ता है
scenes.image_brief: A scuffed old router on a windowsill with one external antenna snapped at the hinge and hanging down, a dusty coiled cable behind it, harsh midday light through the glass.

scenes.narration: Test it once from the furthest room, then write down the result.
scenes.caption: सबसे दूर के कमरे से एक बार जाँचें और नतीजा लिख लें
scenes.image_brief: A laptop open on a desk in the furthest bedroom of a flat with a stopwatch and an open notebook beside it, the bedroom door standing open onto a long hallway, soft daylight.
